baseline.observation: Priority Boarding exiles a revealed card inline rather than exposing the reflexive trigger, preventing a paid counterspell response to the exile choice. An empty-library optional reveal also consumes the turn allowance, suppressing a later roll after native Elixir refills the library. Accepted reveal, declined reveal and countered-reveal controls pass.

baseline.scope: Six partial-state four-player witnesses with supplied battlefield and optional decisions. Native paid Component Pouch rolls, Disallow, Dramatic Reversal and Elixir resolution are used. Forest mana value zero makes eligibility independent of die result; the empty-library test checks a later trigger after refill. Reflexive timing follows rule 603.12; impossible reveal admission is inferred from 608.2d. This is not complete reveal, dice, card or AI certification. The prototype is excluded from the active recipe.

scope: Priority Boarding exposes its separate reflexive exile trigger and preserves the optional reveal allowance when the library is empty. The remembered revealed object retains its last-known identity. Eighteen controlled witnesses include native responses, library movement, queued rolls, copied games and actual cleanup/permission expiry. This is not complete reveal, dice, card or AI certification.
